question: Does a Loyal Lemming (shared LavinMQ) instance delete a queue that has been idle for 28 days, or a temporary queue after 60 seconds, as the shared RabbitMQ plans do? Declare an unconsumed durable queue and a transient queue on a Loyal Lemming instance, then list its queues in the management interface after 60 seconds and after 28 days.
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. The plans page listed Max idle queue time 28 days under Loyal Lemming in the archived copies of 2023-12-18 and 2025-08-03, and the archived copy of 2025-11-18 and the current page list it under Little Lemur and Tough Tiger only; the 60-second rule is stated only in the 2017 post for Little Lemur and Tough Tiger. No page says whether LavinMQ shared plans enforce either rule today, and the test needs an instance, which is the operator's step (rq:operator).
